title: [Informações do servidor] Dodge, Accuracy, PrecisionAccuracy
bodyHtml:
original thread(ru) - *link*

DODGE
A standard Characteristic. The more dodge you have, the greater the chance to dodge the enemy attack. It is impossible to dodge directed mass attacks (for example, Meteorite magic, etc.).

Sources of dodge:
Buffs:
  • Expert Ranged buff "Evasion Range" (+10 - +40). Used only for itself.
  • Elite Holy bellato buff "Agility" (+1 - +10 ).
Equipment:
  • Leon Bow (50 lv 3rd grade - +25, 55 lv 3rd grade - +30).
  • Leon MachineGun (50 lv 3rd grade - +20, 55 lv 3rd grade - +25).
  • Jewelry (+80 from high elemental jewelry, also in the case of using laboratory jewelry - +85 or +90).
  • Upgrading boots with mercy talic (+6- +90 ).
  • Set bonuses from set equipment (council set +25, palmas/didalos/knightwalker set from 4 set - +15, from 5 set +20. Also dodge can be gain from relic sets, improved palmas sets, etc.).
Other:
  • Dodge Potion
  • Relics
Maximum dodge for 1st phase*:
*not including laboratory jewelry or relics
  • Bellato without council set: palmas/didalos/knightwalker 4 set - 291 dodge, palmas/didalos/knightwalker 5 set - 301 dodge.
  • Bellato with council set: 301 dodge.
  • Cora/Accretia without council set: palmas/didalos/knightwalker 4 set - 281 dodge, palmas/didalos/knightwalker 5 set - 291 dodge.
  • Cora/Accretia with council set: 291 dodge.


ACCURACY AND PRECISIONACCURACY
Accuracy characteristic - increases the chance of hitting with hits [normal weapon attack [red damage]], does NOT increase the chance of hitting with skills and is displayed in the character characteristics.

PrecisionAccuracy characteristic - increases the chance of hitting with skills (blue damage) and it is not displayed in the character characteristics.

Sources of PrecisionAccuracy:
Buffs:
  • Expert Melee and Ranged buff "Accurate" and "Precision" (+5 - +30 PrecisionAccuracy). Used only for itself.
  • Elite Dark cora buff "Acuity" ( +1 - +10 PrecisionAccuracy).
  • Class buffs of various classes (+10 - + 30 PrecisionAccuracy [depending on the buff itself]). Used only for itself.
Equipment:
  • Upgrading gloves with grace talic (+6 - +105 PrecisionAccuracy).
Other:
  • PrecisionAccuracy Potion
  • Relics
